diagnose: Reproduce failures and test root-cause hypotheses.
impact: Trace callers, data contracts, and lifecycle risks.
design: Choose simple designs with clear data ownership.
reliability: Make retries converge and serialize shared writes.
review: Triage review findings against real execution paths.
verify: Exercise real journeys and distinguish harness drift.
measure: Measure real work fairly and report uncertainty.
evaluate: Compare anonymous outputs with fixed task criteria.
handoff: Preserve verified state for safe pause and resume.
learn: Turn repeated failures into small verified safeguards.
explain: Explain technical work for the reader and purpose.
formal: Check bounded invariants against actual code behavior.
work: Plan and deliver scoped features and refactors.
compare: Partition independent work and select by evidence.
git: Check current heads and verify approved remote actions.
